name: claude-forge
description: Skills and mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: desktop-update
plugins.description: A line above the prompt when a newer Claude Desktop (Windows, MSIX) is on the update feed, with a one-click install and a switch for Desktop's own auto-update

plugins.name: file-explorer
plugins.description: VS Code style file tree of the session's working directory in a pane

plugins.name: prompt-templates
plugins.description: Prompt template library in a pane: search, tags, {{variables}}, fill, insert, send or copy; /prompts

plugins.name: session-band
plugins.description: Prompt cache status band with hover help, cold-send guard, keep-warm, board, handoff (all under /session-band) and an autonomous mode. Fork of Cache Keeper by Nate Herk.

plugins.name: session-reaper
plugins.description: Frees the memory of idle Claude desktop sessions by stopping their process trees (sessions stay in the sidebar), optionally archives them, and stops idle process trees left behind by ended sessions (Windows)

plugins.name: skill-manager
plugins.description: Side pane listing installed skills with scope, GitHub source, usage, update and delete; /skill-manager
